definitions.gloss: personnel section; human resources department; HR department
definitions.explanation: The department or section within a company or organization that handles hiring, employee records, transfers, evaluations, and other staffing matters.

examples.japanese: {人事課|じんじか}に{書類|しょるい}を{提出|ていしゅつ}する。
examples.english: To submit documents to the HR department.

examples.japanese: {異動|いどう}のことは{人事課|じんじか}に{聞|き}いてください。
examples.english: Please ask the HR department about transfers.

examples.japanese: {人事課|じんじか}から{来年度|らいねんど}の{採用|さいよう}{計画|けいかく}について{説明|せつめい}があった。
examples.english: There was an explanation from the HR department about next year's hiring plan.

notes: Compound of {人事|じんじ} (personnel affairs) + {課|か} (section/department). The {課|か} suffix indicates a subdivision within a larger department ({部|ぶ}). In larger organizations, {人事課|じんじか} may be part of {人事部|じんじぶ} (human resources division). Related department names: {総務課|そうむか} (general affairs section), {経理課|けいりか} (accounting section), {営業課|えいぎょうか} (sales section). In government offices, {人事課|じんじか} handles civil servant appointments and evaluations.
